close_reason: Fixed: two remaining exts.iter() calls in has_key_cert_sign and cert_basic_constraints (4-space indented; missed by round 1 replace_all which matched 8-space version).
description: Round 1 (PKIX-841) fixed the iter() redundancy in check_critical_extensions (line 464) but missed the same pattern in two helper functions: has_key_cert_sign (line 487: 'for ext in exts.iter()') and cert_basic_constraints (line 509: 'for ext in exts.iter()'). Both should be 'for ext in exts' — the collection already yields references when iterated directly. Clippy would flag these as clippy::into_iter_on_ref.
title: redundant .iter() in has_key_cert_sign and cert_basic_constraints
